title: Question Data in New Contexts
description: When using numerical data: - Ask yourself: "Does this data apply to this specific situation?" - Double-check assumptions: Ensure the numbers make sense in the new context. - Explore alternatives: Seek additional information before drawing conclusions. Example: Using an old formula for a new project? Verify if it fits the current conditions first.
